reviews.title: Disappointing postpartum
reviews.text: Their ig marketing oversells the actual content. The circuit workouts I tried felt unnatural and unengaging. Short video transitions felt carelessly spliced together. Disappointed because I had high hopes for this. Unfortunately I was preoccupied and didn’t cancel sooner.

reviews.title: Great work out app, but dodgy subscription service
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with the subscription service and the way this billing issue has been handled.

I purchased a monthly subscription, yet I have been charged twice additionally before my next subscription renewal date. This has happened despite already paying for the full monthly subscription.

As a result, I have had to contact Apple myself to request refunds. Even then, the refunded amounts have not fully covered what I was charged.

I also contacted your customer service team, but the only response I received was to contact Apple. I find this extremely frustrating and disappointing. As the service provider, I would expect your team to take responsibility for investigating the billing issue rather than simply redirecting customers elsewhere.

I have now cancelled my subscription because I cannot continue paying a full monthly subscription fee every 10 days due to repeated unexpected charges.

reviews.title: Always crashes
reviews.text: This app would be great if it didn’t crash half the time. More often than not I can’t even get in the app, it just loads for ages before shutting down. This happens too often, and it has been going on for ages. I paid a subscription and it’s basically a lottery every time I want to use the app. Unless the developers solve this issue for good I would advise against paying for this app.

reviews.title: Not a mom ally
reviews.text:
I was offered two free months of sweat , I am a pregnant mother of two and completely forgot I signed up for it and was charged at one point down the line, I had never used the service and when I reached out to the team they did not sympathise with my position and kept my $45. 
This is the first company that has not honoured my position and offered a refund. A note to busy mommas. Tbh I never used the service. Just the customer service.

reviews.title: Missed opportunity
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Sweat App for the Strength training and the thing that stands out is the lack of guided instruction/ coaching during the workout. So once you start the work out it acts more like a timer than a coaching experience. 

It does have some demonstrations and written instructions but that is frustrating while you are mid workout. Other apps like Ladder provide real time guidance, cues and reminders which make a notable difference to your workout. 

Given that a lot of people using this app would likely be beginners it seems like a missed opportunity not to include in-workouts coaching- even simple things like posture reminders, tempo cues or common mistakes would improve this app significantly.  

Just a fancy timer at this stage.
